items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I worked for him. Oh, yeah. I worked for him with Artiz.

ctx.x: In the later years he owned two blocks from there, the Rampart and Bienville, the doghouse. I worked for him. Oh, yeah. I worked for him with Artiz. Without Artiz Crosby? I worked for him later years over there. He's the paddock farm. Oh, is that right?
